title: 30M Cell Granularity under Local Plasticity

arms.initial_function: exact hidden-dimension partition of each existing FFN expert
arms.local_plasticity_rule: identical across arms; gradient pressure relative to immediate tissue neighbors controls bounded per-cell LR multiplier
arms.local_plasticity_normalization: multipliers renormalized to mean 1.0 within every tissue

continuation.mixture: 25% each; one occurrence per four-step block with deterministic shuffled order

optimizer.micro_cell_parameters: scheduled base LR multiplied by local plasticity

cell_differentiation: specialization gain from the arm's own age-zero baseline
cell profile stability versus age zero

decision_rule.differentiation_signal: final-minus-age0 median specialization gain exceeds the G=1 gain by at least 0.05
decision_rule.performance_guardrail: final balanced NLL ratio versus G=1 is <= 1.02
decision_rule.stability_guardrail: mean final profile cosine versus age zero is >= 0.80

interpretation_limits: Experiment 026 does not enable or test autonomous mitosis.

Exact partition without a cell-local update rule would be only a reparameterized measurement; therefore v2 applies the same local-plasticity rule to every arm and treats G as the resolution of local adaptation.
The symbolic and facts domains are deterministic synthetic training environments, not broad symbolic reasoning or factual-knowledge benchmarks.
The diagnostic stress score is recorded but is not used to trigger growth.
A positive result supports finer cell granularity as a useful substrate for local developmental adaptation; it does not by itself establish full NCA self-organization.
